thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-2026-9145: hosted-inference-prod EAST cluster — sudden 5xx spike and latency SLO breach. urgency: high. paging oncall: elaine.

pagerduty-bot: Paging elaine (oncall-sre-week). Escalation policy: 2m -> secondary -> manager.

elaine: seeing this in my phone but I'm on a train, no stable connection. will try to ack in 10m. :train:

(2m pass)

pagerduty-bot: Incident not acknowledged. Escalating to secondary: @samir.

samir: got the page, heading in. can someone paste error rates?

ops-manager: summary from dashboards: 5xx rate jumped from 0.4% -> ~18% in last 3m for /v1/generate on prod-east, p95 latency doubled to ~1.2s, error budget burn. customer-facing retries failing.

samir: trying to hit runbook. can't reach the autoscaler API (504). suspect control-plane throttling.

pagerduty-bot: Still not acknowledged by primary (elaine). Manager escalation pending in 3m.

elaine: sorry just saw this. my phone battery died. I'm not going to be reliable for the next 20. please proceed and keep me in the loop. acked.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by elaine. (This will not halt escalation if policy requires manager wake).

(3m pass without mitigation)

pagerduty-bot: No mitigation activity detected, escalating to manager: @marco.

marco: I woke up, on it. can you confirm whether this is origin infra (GPU nodes) or model runtime?

jess: logs show high rate of OOM / model reloads on inference-worker-0..3, repeated retries. kernel logs point to GPU memory pressure during long sequential requests.

samir: trying to roll a quick mitigation: reduce max_sequence_length to 512 and pin to quantized-variant (gpt-4-small-q8) as temporary fallback. prepping config patch.

samir: posting runbook commands:
```
# reduce seq len and pin model variant for prod-east route
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/routes/prod-east/update -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","max_seq":512,"model":"gpt-4-small-q8"}'
# scale workers as fallback
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=12
```

marco: do both. rolling change via canary on 10% first. tag me on rollout.

samir: canary applied, 10% traffic now pinned to q8 variant. initial error rate on canary slice down to 1.2%.

ops-manager: good sign. initiating bulk scale-up while we monitor.

(5m later)

jess: bulk scale succeeded, worker pods 12 -> healthy. overall 5xx back down to 2.3%, p95 latency trending down. still above SLO but improving.

marco: nice work. I'm going to clear manager escalation once we have sustained improvement 10m.

pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation auto-cleared (marco).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-9145 status: mitigated -> partial-service restored. please add post-incident notes and runbook gaps.

elaine: thanks team. a few quick notes: need better phone OOO handling in PD (auto-escalate faster if primary shows unack) and add a step in runbook to prefer model-variant pinning earlier.

samir: agreed — also propose an autoscaler retry/backoff check; the control-plane 504 seems to be the choke. filing issue.

jess: assigning postmortem: jess to write (will include timeline, root cause hypotheses: GPU memory growth on long prompts + autoscaler control-plane throttling). tagging ops-manager for prioritization.

ops-manager: confirm. set severity: Sev2. expected postmortem due EOD tomorrow.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-9145 resolved by samir, jess, marco, elaine. Resolved at ts=1869999200.

samir: brief follow-up — I'll open a PR to add the quick fallback to runbook and adjust PD escalation timeouts for primary-with-OOO detection.

marco: thanks everyone. good coordination. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
